name: Bishoujo Dancer Ingyaku Lesson ~Chuunen Furitsukeshi no Tokunou Kojin Jugyou~
original_name: 美少女ダンサー淫虐レッスン ～中年振付師の特濃個人授業～
source:
Celene was a top ballet school coming into her own with interpretive modern dance.
To fulfill her dreams she became the protege of a genius in the artform, Valdi.

But Valdi had more in mind for the nimble nymphet.

"Your balance is so wrong. You must thrust to me."
"Aahhh...... I can't... it's too..."
"Do you want to be best? This is best way."
"Ahhh! Ahhnn! Forgive me!"

[From [url=https://www.dlsite.com/maniax/work/=/product_id/RJ121171.html/?locale=en_US]DLsite English[/url]]
translation:
Celene就读于一所顶尖的芭蕾舞学校，该校正凭借富有表现力的现代舞逐渐崭露头角。为了实现梦想，她成为舞蹈天才Valdi的门生。

然而，Valdi对这位身姿轻盈的少女另有打算。

“你的平衡感太差了。你得对着我挺腰。”
“啊……我不行……太……”
“你想做到最好吗？这就是最好的办法。”
“啊啊！啊嗯！饶了我吧！”

[From [url=https://www.dlsite.com/maniax/work/=/product_id/RJ121171.html/?locale=en_US]DLsite English[/url]]
